name: Teri Meri Doriyaann
description: It’s hate at first sight for Sahiba and Angad! But destined to be together, their lives get intertwined by a marriage alliance, and a love-hate story ensues.

videos.title: Meet the Self-dependent Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba is a hardworking middle-class girl with big dreams for her future. On the other hand, Angad, a perfectionist, prepares to host an anniversary party.

videos.title: Angad to Impress His Grandfather.
videos.overview: Angad plans to decorate his mansion for an event to impress his grandfather. Meanwhile, Sahiba's mother requests her to help Seerat attend the Brars' event.

videos.title: Angad Meets Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba demands an apology from Angad as he breaks her earthen pot. Later, Veer and Angad visit Sahiba's shop and ask her to finish the event's traditional decor.

videos.title: A Challenge for Sahiba.
videos.overview: Angad brings Sahiba to decorate his home for the event, but his family doubts her capability. Will Sahiba be able to prove her talent despite their hesitations?

videos.title: Is Sahiba's Artwork a Letdown?
videos.overview: Daarji and Angad try to find the source behind the rumour. Later, as the Brars get dissatisfied with her work, Sahiba surprises them by adding a twist to it.

videos.title: Angad Gets Praised.
videos.overview: Daarji praises Angad for being able to find a talented artist like Sahiba in such a short time. However, Angad says that Sahiba could have done better work.

videos.title: Sahiba Stitches Seerat's Dress.
videos.overview: Seerat is overjoyed when she receives the passes for the Brars event. Later, Sahiba takes the responsibility to stitch a new dress for Seerat.

videos.title: Sahiba Saves Santosh.
videos.overview: As she enters the venue with Seerat and Keerat, Santosh realises that she left the passes at home. However, Sahiba shows up on time with the passes.

videos.title: Sahiba at the Brars Event.
videos.overview: After several requests from Veer, Sahiba attends the Brars event. Later, Seerat gets angry when Angad does not pay attention to her glamorous look.

videos.title: Veer Makes an Announcement.
videos.overview: Garry gets offended when Veer announces the name of the person who will handle their new project. Elsewhere, Santosh makes a plan for Seerat to impress Angad.

videos.title: Sahiba Saves Seerat.
videos.overview: Sahiba spots a danger for Seerat and saves her from getting injured. However, Angad accuses her of trying to harm Seerat and the latter doesn't defend her.

videos.title: Seerat, Angad Come Closer.
videos.overview: Seerat refuses to acknowledge Sahiba as her sister, humiliates her, and moves closer to Angad. Later, Sahiba leaves and wanders the streets in anguish.

videos.title: Angad Is Dazzled.
videos.overview: Angad is charmed by Seerat's beauty and declares her the winner of the dance competition. Sahiba feels upset at Angad's behaviour after she returns home.

videos.title: Angad Rewards Seerat.
videos.overview: Angad announces Seerat as the winner of the dance competition and rewards her with a diamond set. Sahiba gets worried when Seerat and Santosh do not return home.

videos.title: Keerat Reveals the Truth.
videos.overview: In anger, Keerat opens up to Ajeet about Seerat and Santosh's behaviour towards Sahiba. Later, Sahiba feels dejected when Seerat loses her earring.

videos.title: Santosh, Seerat Devise a Plan.
videos.overview: Santosh gets upset when Seerat's father insults her for not defending Sahiba at the party. Later, Santosh tells Seerat about a plan to return to the Brar mansion.

videos.title: Seerat Visits the Brar Mansion.
videos.overview: After losing her earrings, Seerat finds a good excuse to visit the Brar house. As Angad begins to admire her, Mandeep decides to learn more about Seerat.

videos.title: A Prediction Disturbs Santosh.
videos.overview: Santosh is concerned about her daughters’ future when a Baba makes a prediction concerning Seerat. Meanwhile, Sahiba refers to Seerat as her Didi in front of Angad.

videos.title: Seerat Spins a Web of Deception.
videos.overview: During the meal with the Brars, Seerat makes up tales to win them over. She amazes Angad with Sahiba's wise words while he keenly tries to learn more about her.

videos.title: Garry Tries to Manipulate Seerat.
videos.overview: Mandeep is impressed with Seerat and decides to meet her parents. Later, Garry tries to manipulate Seerat with his fake stories and the latter falls into his trap.

videos.title: Angad Grows Agitated.
videos.overview: Angad gets furious and blames Sahiba and question her intention when she saves him from the fire. Later, Sahiba gets infuriated and lectures Angad for yelling at her.

videos.title: Ajeet Feels Dejected.
videos.overview: A conflict ensues between Sahiba and Angad when he insults her. Later, Ajeet feels disheartened when Santosh and Seerat question his responsibility towards her daughter.

videos.title: Santosh Gets Shocked.
videos.overview: Santosh creates a scene when Ajeet takes a firm decision not to support her vile plans. However, Santosh and her family get shocked to see vermilion on Sahiba's forehead

videos.title: Jasleen Brings Up Her Past.
videos.overview: Jasleen talks about how her marriage ruined her life and blames her family for not supporting her at all. Later, Angad's grandfather agrees to Angad and Seerat's wedding.

videos.title: Garry's Shocking Condition.
videos.overview: Garry plans a date for Angad and Seerat but asks Seerat to pay for the date. Later, Seerat requests Sahiba for the money and Santosh forces Sahiba to agree.

videos.title: Kiara Lies to Angad.
videos.overview: Kiara shows Angad the jewellery designs she bought from Sahiba and pretends that she made the designs herself. Later, Angad and his father share a close moment.

videos.title: Seerat Faces Harassment.
videos.overview: Gary delays Angad for his date. He appoints goons to harass Seerat so he can pretend to be her saviour. However, Keerat comes to rescue Seerat.

videos.title: Garry Impresses Seerat.
videos.overview: Garry tries to impress Seerat and gifts her the ring Angad had bought for her. Elsewhere, Santosh faces tough questions about her family from the Brars.

videos.title: Santosh in a Tough Spot.
videos.overview: Santosh lands in trouble when Mandeep decides to visit her house to fix Angad and Seerat's wedding date. Elsewhere, Sahiba gets furious when Angad insults her.

videos.title: Sahiba Opposes Santosh.
videos.overview: Santosh gets restless and blames Ajeet for their financial condition. She also fumes in anger when Sahiba gives her shocking opinion about Angad.

videos.title: Jasleen's Evil Motive.
videos.overview: While Santosh attempts suicide, Seerat decides to disclose her love for Garry. Meanwhile, Jasleen devises a nefarious plot against Angad.

videos.title: Seerat Meets the Brars.
videos.overview: Sahiba goes all out to satisfy the Brars when they come to meet Seerat. However, Seerat gets anxious after visiting her aunt's lavish house.

videos.title: Santosh Convinces Her Sister.
videos.overview: Seerat gets confused as Garry invites her to become the chief guest of the event. Later, Santosh sobs before her sister and convinces her to welcome the Brars.

videos.title: A Tricky Situation for Santosh.
videos.overview: Seerat makes up an excuse and takes permission from Santosh to leave the house. Later, the Brars come to meet Seerat and Santosh gets worried when she fails to find her.

videos.title: Garry Tries to Impress Seerat.
videos.overview: Santosh struggles to keep the truth from the Brars and later discovers that Seerat has eloped. Meanwhile, Garry uses flattering words to entice Seerat.

videos.title: Seerat's Dilemma.
videos.overview: Ajeet informs the Brars that he has two more daughters besides Seerat. On the other hand, Garry's appealing assurances place Seerat in a quandary.

videos.title: Santosh Weaves a Web of Lies.
videos.overview: When Seerat admits that she likes Garry, Sahiba shows up and catches her. Elsewhere, Santosh manipulates the Brars by spinning a web of lies.

videos.title: Angad Accuses Sahiba.
videos.overview: Just as the Brars are about to leave, Sahiba suddenly brings Seerat back. Later, Angad is surprised to see Sahiba and accuses her of Seerat's disappearance.

videos.title: Seerat, Angad's Wedding Gets Fixed.
videos.overview: Mandeep announces her decision to fix Seerat and Angad's wedding. Jabjot desires to conduct the Roka ceremony in a grand way for the couple at the Brar mansion.

videos.title: Seerat's Desperate Move.
videos.overview: Seerat gets desperate to stop her engagement with Angad, and she holds Garry's hand in front of all the guests. However, Garry quickly comes up with an excuse.

videos.title: Santosh Falls Sick.
videos.overview: Santosh gets worried and falls unconscious when Mandeep confirms Seerat and Angad's marriage plans. Later, Sahiba and Keerat enter the Brar mansion in disguise.

videos.title: Santosh's Clever Ploy.
videos.overview: Santosh asks the doctor to lie about her being terminally ill in an attempt to make the Brars prepone Seerat and Angad's wedding. Will the doctor agree to lie?

videos.title: Seerat Confesses Her Feelings.
videos.overview: The Brars are fooled by Santosh's act and decide to move up the wedding. However, this news makes Seerat desperate as she wants to marry Garry instead of Angad.

videos.title: Santosh Plans to Sell the House.
videos.overview: Santosh requests Sahiba to take a loan in order to arrange the money for Seerat's grand wedding. Later, Santosh plans to sell the house when Sahiba refuses.

videos.title: Sahiba Questions Seerat.
videos.overview: Seerat confesses her feelings to Garry and he promises to spend his life with her. Later, Seerat gets caught by Sahiba while trying to sneak into the house.

videos.title: Santosh Warns Sahiba.
videos.overview: Santosh mortgages the house and lavishly spends on Seerat's wedding preparations. She also asks Sahiba not to interfere when the latter questions her.

videos.title: A Tough Choice for Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba decides to not attend Seerat's wedding because of Angad. However, she faces a conundrum when Veer requests her to design Angad's Sehra.

videos.title: Seerat Plans to Elope.
videos.overview: While everyone is busy preparing for her and Angad's wedding, Seerat decides to run away with Garry. Elsewhere, Santosh worries about Seerat's fate.

videos.title: Sahiba Makes a Shocking Discovery.
videos.overview: Sahiba is shocked to discover Angad and Seerat's wedding banner while doing the decorations. Later, Seerat requests Garry to escape with her before the wedding.

videos.title: Seerat, Angad's Engagement.
videos.overview: Imlie attends Seerat and Angad's sangeet ceremony and praises their loving bond. Further, Angad and Seerat exchange their rings and give a dance performance.

videos.title: Sahiba Meets an Old Friend.
videos.overview: Sahiba is delighted to come across Sai at the wedding and the latter makes a shocking prediction about Sahiba's future. Later, a mistake happens at the Haldi ceremony.

videos.title: Garry Makes His Move.
videos.overview: Angad learns about a fire in one of his stores and Garry offers to go there on his behalf. However, Garry plans to use this as an excuse to elope with Seerat.

videos.title: Santosh Finds Seerat's Letter.
videos.overview: Santosh is shocked to find Seerat's letter and learns that she has eloped with someone else. Later, Santosh decides to commit suicide, but Sahiba stops her.

videos.title: Jasleen's Shocking Demand.
videos.overview: Jasleen barges in on Santosh and her daughters discussing Seerat's action and threatens to expose their lies to the Brars. Later, she makes a shocking demand to Sahiba.

videos.title: Santosh's Request to Sahiba.
videos.overview: Tension rises among the Brars as the media questions them about Seerat. Meanwhile, Santosh requests Sahiba to be Angad's bride.

videos.title: Sahiba's Tremendous Sacrifice.
videos.overview: Sahiba disguises herself as Angad's bride and hopes that Seerat will return shortly. However, Ajeet finds out the truth and confronts Santosh.

videos.title: Sahiba's Shocking Move.
videos.overview: Santosh convinces Ajeet to let Sahiba get married to Angad. Later, Sahiba drops the facade and reveals her face before the wedding.

videos.title: What’ll be Angad’s Next Move?
videos.overview: Keerat spots Seerat in a car and tries to chase her down, but Garry drives away. Meanwhile, Sahiba refuses to get married to Angad.

videos.title: Angad Targets Sahiba.
videos.overview: Angad gets furious when the news channels blow up the controversy at his wedding. Later, he accuses Sahiba as the mastermind behind Seerat's plan.

videos.title: Akaal's Advice for Angad.
videos.overview: Akaal tells Angad that punishing Sahiba will ruin the family's reputation and advises him to marry her. However, Angad's parents are not happy about it.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes a Tough Decision.
videos.overview: Upon Ajeet's request, Sahiba agrees to marry Angad thinking about her family's dignity. Later, she gets emotional, bidding goodbye to her family.

videos.title: Akaal Stands Up for Sahiba.
videos.overview: Garry makes fake promises to Seerat in order to get romantic with her. Elsewhere, Akaal defends Sahiba and makes Mandeep welcome her properly.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes a Stand.
videos.overview: Mandeep welcomes Sahiba into the house but presents a shocking condition to let her stay. However, Sahiba refuses to adhere to her demands.

videos.title: Garry Realises His Mistake.
videos.overview: Garry learns from Jasleen that Sahiba is Seerat's sister and that Seerat fooled him by pretending to be rich. Elsewhere, Sahiba chooses the storeroom for herself.

videos.title: Santosh Faces Humiliation.
videos.overview: Santosh's neighbours come to the house and humiliate her for Seerat's actions. Later, Angad ignores Sahiba's generous actions and punishes her.

videos.title: Garry's Sudden Outburst.
videos.overview: A furious Garry shouts at Seerat when she asks him to marry her. Elsewhere, Jasleen complains to Angad about Sahiba's absence from the house.

videos.title: Angad Probes Sahiba.
videos.overview: Angad questions Sahiba about her sudden disappearance from the house. Daarji criticises Angad for his behaviour in not giving food to Sahiba.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes a Stand.
videos.overview: Angad refuses to perform the Kanak Deni ritual with Sahiba and hands her the gifts insultingly. However, Sahiba refuses to take anything from Angad.

videos.title: Santosh Gets Insulted.
videos.overview: Santosh ignores Ajeet's advice and goes to the Brar mansion to see Sahiba. When Angad humiliates her for her actions, Sahiba defends Santosh.

videos.title: Sahiba Exposes Jasleen.
videos.overview: Angad threatens to punish Santosh for her crime and decides to call the police. However, when Sahiba reveals the truth about Jasleen's involvement, she denies it.

videos.title: Manbeer's Shocking Act.
videos.overview: Jasleen makes up a story and convinces Angad that she was manipulated by Sahiba. However, Manbeer doesn't believe her and slaps her for ruining Angad's life.

videos.title: Akaal to Host the Reception.
videos.overview: Santosh lies to Ajeet and Keerat about the Brars' behaviour towards her. Akaal is determined to host a reception to give the impression that they agreed to the marriage.

videos.title: Sahiba Stands Her Ground.
videos.overview: Angad asks Sahiba to get ready for their reception and to wear the expensive clothes given to her by the Brars. However, she decides to wear her clothes.

videos.title: Sahiba Rejects Jabjot's Request.
videos.overview: Sahiba refuses when Jabjot wants her to dress beautifully for the reception. Elsewhere, Seerat learns that Garry will be attending the reception.

videos.title: Angad Faces the Media.
videos.overview: At the reception, the media questions Angad, making him awkward. The Brars wait for Sahiba to intervene and save the day.

videos.title: Sahiba, Angad's Grand Reception.
videos.overview: Sahiba and Angad attend their grand reception and pretend in front of the media that they love each other. Later, Sahiba learns about Angad's kind nature.

videos.title: A Shocker for Garry.
videos.overview: Garry is shocked to see Seerat at the reception party in disguise which keeps her from being spotted by Sahiba. Later, the police come to the party to speak to Sahiba.

videos.title: Garry Manipulates Seerat.
videos.overview: Garry instigates Seerat against Sahiba and tells her that Sahiba has turned the Brars against Seerat. Later, Angad decides to throw Sahiba out of the house.

videos.title: Sahiba Shares Her Suspicion.
videos.overview: Sahiba reveals that Seerat might have been kidnapped in an attempt to ruin the Brars' reputation. Garry gets worried to learn about Sahiba's suspicion.

videos.title: Angad Misbehaves with Sahiba.
videos.overview: Garry provokes Angad, making him beleive that he has fallen into Sahiba's trap. Consequently, an intoxicated Angad misbehaves with Sahiba.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes Care of Angad.
videos.overview: Sahiba feels guilty about Seerat's actions and takes care of an intoxicated Angad. Later, the Brars are shocked to see Angad coming out of Sahiba's room in the morning.

videos.title: Angad Gets into Trouble.
videos.overview: Angad is confused about his night's stay in Sahiba's room. Sahiba tells Angad of his weird conduct, Jasleen mocks him for staying with Sahiba.

videos.title: Angad Apologise to Sahiba.
videos.overview: Veer takes Sahiba's side and tells the Brars about the previous night's incident. On Daarji's order, Angad agrees to apologise to Sahiba for his misconduct.

videos.title: Keerat Comes to Meet Sahiba.
videos.overview: Manbeer plans to teach Sahiba a lesson when the latter humiliates her in front of Akaal. Later, a disguised Keerat comes to the Brar mansion to meet Sahiba.

videos.title: Sahiba Wins Hearts.
videos.overview: Sahiba is shocked to see Keerat at the house while Akaal stops Angad from throwing the kids out of the house. Later, Sahiba impresses Akaal with her decoration.

videos.title: Angad in Search for Seerat.
videos.overview: Jasleen grows suspicious when she overhears a girl's voice beside Garry while talking to him. Angad discovers Seerat's hideout and decides to confront her.

videos.title: Angad's Shocking Decision.
videos.overview: Garry informs Seerat that Angad has found her and she runs away before Angad enters the room. Later, Angad agrees to take part in the Pag Phera ritual with Sahiba.

videos.title: Jasleen Confronts Keerat.
videos.overview: Manbeer declares that Angad will not go to Sahiba's house with her, but Angad convinces her to let him go. Later, Jasleen confronts Keerat about her disguise.

videos.title: Manbeer's Shocking Condition.
videos.overview: Sahiba gives a befitting reply when Garry tries to humiliate her. Later, Sahiba is stunned when a furious Manbeer traps Angad with a shocking condition.

videos.title: Angad, Sahiba Visit the Mongas.
videos.overview: Sahiba and Angad visit her parents for the first time after their marriage. Elsewhere, Seerat decides to return to the Mongas' house to question Sahiba.

videos.title: Angad Disagrees With Sahiba
videos.overview: Sahiba urges Angad to share a room with her but he refuses to do so. Later, Ajeet's emotional revelation convinces Sahiba to forgive Santosh.

videos.title: Hansraj Instigates Manbeer.
videos.overview: Hansraj poisons Manbeer's mind by telling her that Sahiba has plans to take Angad away from her life. Meanwhile, Angad attends the feast with his in-laws.

videos.title: Seerat to Enter the House
videos.overview: To annoy Angad, Sahiba serves him spicy food. Seerat tries to enter the house and gets emotional after hearing her neighbours gossip.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes Care of Angad.
videos.overview: Sahiba helps Angad to get on the bed and puts an ice pack on his back to ease his pain. Later, Manbeer learns about Angad's injury and rushes to see him.

videos.title: Manbeer Throws Accusations.
videos.overview: Manbeer blames Santosh and Sahiba for Angad's injury, but the latter defends them. Later, Angad refuses to return home with Manbeer which upsets her.

videos.title: Seerat Accuses Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba gets surprised after she spots Seerat in the house and questions about her sudden disappearance. However, Seerat blames Sahiba for her plight.

videos.title: Sahiba Shows Mercy.
videos.overview: Santosh and Ajeet blame Seerat for ruining Sahiba's life and ask her to leave the house. However, Sahiba sympathises with Seerat and tries to stop them.

videos.title: Seerat Gives an Ultimatum.
videos.overview: Seerat promises not to forgive her parents for throwing her out of the house. Later, she tells Garry to marry her, but the latter refuses.

videos.title: Seerat Gets Shattered.
videos.overview: After Garry refuses to have feelings for Seerat, she feels devastated. She realises her mistake and calls Sahiba to apologise for misunderstanding her.

videos.title: Sahiba's Attempt to Save Seerat.
videos.overview: When Sahiba jumps into the river to save Seerat, Angad follows in to rescue them. Later, Sahiba blames her parents for Seerat's decision.

videos.title: Sahiba Stands Her Ground.
videos.overview: When Angad blames Sahiba for prompting Seerat to take a drastic step, she tries to clear his misunderstanding. Later, Garry gets worried learning about Seerat.

videos.title: Seerat Apologises to Angad.
videos.overview: After Seerat regains her senses, Angad probes her about the boy she fled with. However, Seerat breaks down and seeks forgiveness from Angad for ditching him.

videos.title: Sahiba to Find the Culprit.
videos.overview: Santosh warns Seerat against revealing Garry's name in front of Angad. Meanwhile, Sahiba gets determined to find the person responsible for Seerat's condition.

videos.title: Sahiba's Befitting Reply.
videos.overview: Sahiba gives a stern reply when the neighbours question Seerat's return. However, she becomes doubtful about Seerat and Santosh's conversation.

videos.title: Sahiba Challenges Angad.
videos.overview: Sahiba returns to the Brar mansion and faces questions about Seerat's escape. When Angad blames her for the situation, she challenges him to find the culprit.

videos.title: Manbeer's Adamant Attitude.
videos.overview: Manbeer wants to leave the house as Angad refuses to tell her about his conversation with Sahiba. Later, Keerat objects to Manbeer criticising Sahiba.

videos.title: Sahiba Saves Manbeer's Life.
videos.overview: When Manbeer faints, Sahiba's presence of mind helped to save her. Later, Sahiba decides to confront Seerat after learning about Garry and her truth.

videos.title: Seerat Faces Sahiba's Question.
videos.overview: Seerat grows anxious when Sahiba visits the Mongas' house and questions her about Garry. Meanwhile, Sahiba is determined to bring Garry's truth to light.

videos.title: Seerat's Shocking Ultimatum.
videos.overview: Garry tries to humiliate Sahiba, but she gives him a befitting reply. Later, he gets restless when he receives a shocking ultimatum from Seerat.

videos.title: Sahiba, Angad's Heated Argument.
videos.overview: Sahiba and Angad get into an argument when the latter exposes his truth in front of Manbeer. Later, Sahiba gets humiliated for cooking food for the Brars.

videos.title: Sahiba's Vaisakhi Celebration.
videos.overview: Sahiba makes arrangements to celebrate Vaisakhi while the Brars gather to witness it. Later, Garry gets tensed as Seerat orders him to meet her at Gurudwara.

videos.title: Sahiba Learns Seerat's Plan.
videos.overview: Keerat informs Sahiba that Seerat is planning to meet Garry at the Gurudwara. To unveil her truth in front of Angad, Sahiba urges him to accompany her.

videos.title: Garry Spots Sahiba, Angad.
videos.overview: Sahiba sees Seerat at the Gurudwara and keeps an eye on her. However, Garry spots Sahiba and Angad from afar and runs away before getting caught.

videos.title: Sahiba Gets Injured.
videos.overview: A brawl breaks out outside the Gurudwara, and Sahiba sustains wounds while attempting to save Angad. Later, Angad helps Sahiba quench her thirst.

videos.title: Angad Confronts Garry.
videos.overview: Sahiba provides proof against Garry in front of Angad. Angad gets shocked to find Garry with Seerat at the Gurdwara and confronts him for betraying his trust.

videos.title: Garry Misleads Angad.
videos.overview: Garry cooks up a story and manages to convince Angad that Sahiba is lying about his relationship with Seerat. Later, Angad asks Sahiba to prove her claims.

videos.title: Angad Refuses to Believe.
videos.overview: Sahiba stops the reporters from interfering with Angad and her personal life. Angad refuses to accept Garry's true colours and remains in confusion.

videos.title: Sahiba Gets Insulted.
videos.overview: Seerat threatens to go to the police if Garry doesn't tell Angad the truth about their relationship. Later, Sahiba gets insulted by Manbeer's friend.

videos.title: Seerat Issues an Ultimatum.
videos.overview: When Shanaya’s mother discusses a marriage proposal for Garry, the Brars agree to it. Meanwhile, Seerat gives a last chance to Garry, and Sahiba overhears them.

videos.title: Garry Instigates Seerat.
videos.overview: Angad gets infuriated on discovering that Sahiba is not in the house. When Seerat forces Garry to marry her, he pits her against Sahiba.

videos.title: Sahiba Confronts Seerat.
videos.overview: Sahiba finds Seerat looking for Garry and asks her to tell the truth about him to the Brars. Later, Santosh makes a shocking promise about Seerat's future. .

videos.title: Sahiba Speaks up for Angad.
videos.overview: Jasleen has an opportunity to bring down Sahiba and Angad after Garry's marriage to Shanaya is fixed. However, Sahiba steps forward to defend Angad's honour.

videos.title: Karan Asks to Marry Seerat.
videos.overview: Karan reveals his wish to marry Seerat but she rejects his proposal. However, Seerat's parents tell her that she has to marry Karan.

videos.title: Garry Confronts Sahiba.
videos.overview: Garry approaches Sahiba and confesses all of his plans, culminating in a conflict. Angad shows up just when Sahiba slaps Garry out of anger.

videos.title: A Shocker for Seerat!
videos.overview: Seerat learns about Garry's wedding with Shanaya and decides to visit the Brars. However, Santosh imprisons Seerat to prevent her from fleeing her marriage.

videos.title: Keerat's Request to Seerat.
videos.overview: Keerat urges Seerat to confront Garry before his engagement. Elsewhere, Sahiba realises the truth after she spots Garry with Sona.

videos.title: Seerat Realises the Truth.
videos.overview: Seerat is shocked to see Garry with Shanaya and realises that he was playing with her heart all along. Manbeer spots Seerat at the party and insults her.

videos.title: Garry Gets Exposed.
videos.overview: Jasleen asks Seerat to leave the party, but Akaal allows her to stay. Garry goes speechless as Seerat confronts him about promising to marry her.

videos.title: Seerat Discloses the Truth.
videos.overview: The Brars get shocked when Seerat reveals Garry's involvement in her escape from the wedding. Sahiba stands against Seerat's humiliation.

videos.title: Garry Faces the Brars' Fury.
videos.overview: As Garrys truth unravels, Shanaya cancels the marriage and the Brars unleash their anger. In a fit of rage, Jasleen shoots Garry.

videos.title: Angad's Harsh Behaviour.
videos.overview: Sahiba tells Angad that he shouldn't punish himself for Garry's actions, but Angad asks her to leave him alone. Later, Seerat calls off her wedding with Karan.

videos.title: Angad Tries to Stop Sahiba.
videos.overview: Angad refuses to let Sahiba leave the house and talks about its repercussions on their families. Later, Sahiba gets shocked when he apologises to her parents.

videos.title: Angad Feels Guilty.
videos.overview: Veer tries to console Angad when he blames himself for Garry's actions. Later, Jasleen accuses Sahiba of manipulating Garry, but Angad defends her.

videos.title: Angad Receives an Order.
videos.overview: Angad gets furious at Sahiba for interfering in his business. Afterwards, Akaal asks Angad to share a room with Sahiba, but the latter refuses.

videos.title: Angad's Absurd Move.
videos.overview: Manbeer gets furious at Sahiba as she learns that Angad slept in the garden. Later, Sahiba agrees to move into Angad's room, but he comes up with a strange rule.

videos.title: Sahiba Impresses the Client.
videos.overview: Angad keeps the cash for Sahiba after seeing her bank account details. Later, Sahiba arrives at Angad's office and wins over the client with the new project.

videos.title: A Tiff Between Angad-Sahiba.
videos.overview: Angad and Sahiba get into a conflict over having the best part of their bedroom. Later, Sahiba encourages Seerat to move on in her life.

videos.title: Angad Gets Furious.
videos.overview: Jabjot gives Sahiba the responsibility to organise Angad's birthday party. Later, Angad gets furious when Garry confronts him to apologise for all the mishaps.

videos.title: Angad Makes a Decision.
videos.overview: The Brars get shocked to see Sahiba's parents and Seerat at Angad's birthday party. Later, Angad shares his decision about Garry and Seerat's marriage.

videos.title: Sahiba Is Determined.
videos.overview: Sahiba refuses to change her mind about officiating Seerat and Garry's wedding. Akaal agrees to Angad's suggestion and wants to give Garry a chance.

videos.title: A Tough Time for Seerat.
videos.overview: As Sahiba refuses Angad's proposal, Seerat resolves to take a decision about her life. Angad orders Garry to fulfil Seerat's dream after the wedding.

videos.title: Seerat Seeks Angad's Help.
videos.overview: Jasleen and Kiara visit Seerat's house to convince her parents to the wedding. Seerat asks Angad to promise that he will take care of her even after she weds Garry.

videos.title: The Brars Get Enraged.
videos.overview: After agreeing to marry Garry, Seerat asks Angad to hold off announcing her decision. The Brars get infuriated when they learn that Sahiba is busy with her business.

videos.title: Sahiba Receives Restrictions.
videos.overview: After seeing Sahiba's photo, the Brars forbid her from working outside or owning her own business. How will Sahiba deal with the situation now?

videos.title: A Shocker for Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba is shocked when she learns that Santosh had taken a loan by mortgaging their house. When Ajeet agrees to Garry and Seerat's wedding, Sahiba firmly objects.

videos.title: Garry, Seerat's Ring Ceremony.
videos.overview: The Mongas and the Brars gather for Garry and Seerat's engagement. However, everyone gets a shock by Angad's strange move during the ceremony.

videos.title: Ajeet Reveals a Shocker.
videos.overview: Ajeet tells Seerat to take a last look at the house as they will soon have to vacate the place. Elsewhere, Sahiba tries to finalise a contract to save the house.

videos.title: Seerat Faces Humiliation.
videos.overview: Angad helps Sahiba arrange the first installment to save the Mongas' house. Later, Sahiba and Angad take a stand for Seerat when she faces humiliation.

videos.title: Garry, Seerat's Wedding.
videos.overview: Seerat and Garry take part in all wedding rituals in the presence of the family. Later, Seerat questions Garry about the reason for marrying her.

videos.title: Sahiba Takes a Stand.
videos.overview: When Inder warns the Brars by comparing Seerat to Garry, Sahiba gives a befitting reply. Later, Sahiba informs Angad about her decision to continue her work.

videos.title: Angad Offers Help.
videos.overview: Garry tells Seerat not to talk about his absence from the room at night. Angad visits Sahiba's parents and gives them a cheque to repay their debt.

videos.title: Sahiba, Angad at Odds.
videos.overview: Sahiba confronts Angad and refuses to accept any financial support from him for her family. Later, Sahiba's steadfast refusal sparks a rift among the Brars.

videos.title: Akaal Proposes a Solution.
videos.overview: Akaal offers Sahiba to create artwork for the Brar house in exchange for whopping fees. However, Sahiba declines the offer and makes a strange choice.

videos.title: Ajeet to Sell the Shop?
videos.overview: After a man offers a sizable sum to buy his shop, Ajeet finds himself in a dilemma. However, Sahiba tries to convince him not to sell the shop.

videos.title: Sahiba Faces Trouble.
videos.overview: Seerat asks Ajeet to reconsider his decision and sell the shop. While Sahiba remains firm on her stand, a few men vandalise the shop.

videos.title: Angad Saves Sahiba.
videos.overview: Sahiba gets stuck inside her shop while trying to douse the fire. To rescue her, Angad enters the shop but gets severely injured.

videos.title: Sahiba Gets Blamed.
videos.overview: The family blames Sahiba for Angad's condition, and they refuse to let her stay in the hospital. Elsewhere, Seerat puts Garry in a difficult situation.

videos.title: Seerat Restricts Sahiba.
videos.overview: Seerat convinces Akaal to let her and Garry stay at the hospital with Angad for the night. Later, Sahiba comes to see Angad, but Seerat stops her.

videos.title: Angad Decides to Tell the Truth.
videos.overview: Seerat restricts Sahiba from meeting Angad, but the latter takes a stand for her. Later, Angad tries to tell the truth to Sahiba about how the shop caught fire.

videos.title: Sahiba Learns the Truth.
videos.overview: Sahiba is shocked to know about Angad's involvement in her shop's incident. Angad admits his foolish act, for which Sahiba suffered a loss.

videos.title: Jasleen Manipulates Seerat.
videos.overview: Jasleen instigates Seerat against Akaal and asks her to make Garry look good in front of him. Elsewhere, Angad feels guilty and tries to apologise to Sahiba.
